tagline: The 1.01, a 62.62 floor, and a rare seller.

file.Nemesis: The bench and fumbduckdumbfuck. 35.6 stayed on a 56.3-point bench in the 101.68-point loss.
file.The desk is watching: Zygon in Week 9, the 1.01 at 993.12 MAXPF, and whether a buyer who just took a 2nd keeps selling.

headline: 3-5, 10th, the 1.01, and the lowest score of the week
story: Week 8 was a 164.3 to 62.62 loss to fumbduckdumbfuck, the biggest margin of the week at 101.68. Malik Willis led at 15.64, the bench scored 56.3 with 35.6 of it good enough to start, and Sleeper's projection of 94.86 was missed by 34%. He stayed 10th at 3-5 with 813.22 points, 11th in the league.

The ledger ran the other way for once: he sent Jonah Coleman to StealingGas for K. Miller and a 2027 2nd, after buying Deebo Samuel, Jake Ferguson and Matthew Stafford. His 993.12 MAXPF is still the lowest in the league and holds the 1.01, with Sarge71 44.6 above and Darkspaces 63.26. FAAB is $400 and Zygon is next.
takes: A 62.62 from the 1.01 holder, and the pick did not move.
A buyer sold a back and took a 2nd.
